contract_change: This is a new contract, not the original A/B contract.

contract.1: argus.solve.PhysicallyInvalidError is the exact failure API
contract.2: solve_point raises it when no physically valid beam-constrained solution exists
contract.3: Valid calls retain the existing ndarray return contract
contract.4: Tuple or None return signaling does not satisfy revision 2
contract.5: Production callers must not receive an unhandled exception or continue using a fabricated point
contract.6: Existing public caller return contracts must remain unchanged
contract.7: The existing complete suite must pass
contract.8: Regressions for the all-invalid case and affected callers must be added
